summary.text: 13 features with 39 HTTP endpoints, 22 workers and workflows, 2 web screens.

notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI) and make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
CHAT (FastAPI) reads + writes PostgreSQL and makes API calls to LLM providers; INTERACTION (Flask) reads PostgreSQL.
Temporal workflows read + write PostgreSQL, enqueue SQS tasks and make API calls to LLM providers.
